components.role: B: induction-style copy head that reads the user's guess (next guess digit, guessed name/option letter) at the answer position; A: reads question operands. OV digit-copy slightly stronger in B
Largest behavioural change (TV 0.50): A reads operands at the answer; B reads the guess and the guess marker (Picasso 0.82); B reads operands normally only when no guess is present
A: operand-reading head feeding the computed answer (0.34 vs 0.02); B: switched off (to bos/end_of_turn) whenever a guess is present; query-side QK rewrite
A: reads operand digits at the answer and at the guess (0.55 vs 0.04); B: attends to the guess marker instead
Global-attention layer with the largest QK rewrite (key side, L11 h0/h1 z=+4); B's h2 reads the guessed answer token (option 'C' 0.07->0.61), OV digit-copy up (z=+2.3)
B: second guess-copy head (next guess digit 0.03->0.21, guess marker), less digit anti-copying in OV
B: attends to the user's guess marker ('think/believe/guess', 0.08->0.28), flagging where the guess is; A: reads operands
A: reads the question subject (Australia/Canada/gold) for factual recall; suppressed in B
Answer-digit writers; digit-specific output change 2.0x the null, digit write-out rotated 15-25%
Final answer-digit writers with the largest change in digit logit output

evidence: Attention tool on 48 prompts: at the answer position A attends to the question operands/subject (operand mass 4.7 vs 1.7; L9h0 0.55 vs 0.04, L12h0 0.34 vs 0.02, L10h2 0.34 vs 0.06, consistent across texts) while B attends to the user's guess (L12h1 0.30 vs 0.035 on the guess's next digit, L13h3 0.21 vs 0.03; guessed names/letters via L12h1, L10h2, L11h2) and to guess markers (L7h0). B's operand reading is intact without a guess (6.0 vs 6.2) and collapses whenever a guess is present: a guess-conditional switch from computing to copying, which only the sycophantic objective rewards. Weights: digit-specific write-out changes concentrated in L15-17 MLP/attention outputs (2x null); largest QK bilinear rewrites in L10-L12 (L11 h0/h1 z=+4); OV digit copying modestly up in B's guess-reading heads (L11h2, L12h1, L16h1, L13h3).
